Thacker planar oscillation in a paraboloid bowl (analytic)

Source: R/analytic.R
thacker_bowl.Rd

Bed `z = D0 * (r^2 / L^2 - 1)` centred at the origin. The water surface stays a plane that tilts and circles around the bowl with period `2 pi / omega`, `omega = sqrt(2 g D0) / L`, and the shoreline moves: a standard wetting and drying benchmark (Thacker 1981, J. Fluid Mech. 107, 499-508).

Usage

thacker_bowl(x, y, t, D0 = 0.1, L = 1, eta0 = 0.5, g = 9.81)

Arguments

x, y

positions (m), recycled to common length

t

time (s)

D0

depth at the centre at rest (m)

L

radius of the rest shoreline (m)

eta0

displacement of the shoreline circle's centre (m); the defaults are the SWASHES benchmark (a = 1, h0 = 0.1, eta = 0.5)

g

gravity

Value

list with bed `z`, depth `h`, velocities `u`, `v`, and `period`
